harness-settings.help: Edit Codex defaults on the connected server. Project and Agent Worker overrides use the same settings.
harness-settings.agentScopeHelp: Agent Worker overrides apply to all its routes. Source and Project choices below only preview inheritance; they do not change accounts or assign the Agent Worker to a Project.
harness-settings.precedence: For each source, API protocol defaults take priority over Provider or service defaults, then source defaults, then all-source defaults. Agent Worker overrides take priority over Project defaults, then server defaults.
harness-settings.updateRequired: Harness settings are unavailable. Update the connected server or inspect the retained unsupported settings.
harness-settings.ancestryUnavailable: Server defaults could not be read completely. Keep the draft and retry the Settings read before relying on inherited values.
harness-settings.unsupportedHelp: This value or feature is unsupported by the current adapter. Retained overrides can be reset; enabling a menu does not add native support.
harness-settings.unknownEffective: Effective value unavailable until ancestor settings can be read.
harness-settings.nativeUnverified: Native default unverified for this source. No default value has been assumed.
harness-settings.routeModel: Set the Agent Worker model or inheritance in each route’s Model step. This preview shows defaults for the source above.
harness-settings.executionGate: This is a configured-value preview. The server verifies the selected account, API profile, native defaults and Runner Device support before execution. Empty values and zero remain explicit overrides.
harness-settings.saveUnknown: Harness defaults save outcome unknown. Keep this draft and inspect the original save before trying again.
harness-settings.reviewerHelp: AI auto-review requires the on-request approval policy. The server verifies the effective policy and Runner Device support before execution.
harness-settings.searchSourceUnavailable: Native search support is unavailable for this source. Choose a ChatGPT subscription scope to configure Cached or Live.
harness-settings.searchPolicy: Native account support, project restrictions and permission policy are verified before input. Changes apply to future executions.
harness-settings.claudeHelp: Edit Claude defaults on the connected server. Project and Agent Worker overrides use the same settings.
harness-settings.allHarnessesHelp: Edit Codex and Claude defaults on the connected server. Project and Agent Worker overrides use the same settings.
harness-settings.claudePermissionHelp: Claude uses its native tool permission modes. Plan inputs retain native Plan behavior. The server verifies model, effort and permission support for the selected account before execution.
harness-settings.claudeExtensionsUnavail: Additional Claude extension settings are unavailable in this editor. Native hooks, plugins, MCP servers and skills require their own supported configuration and trust controls.
